purpose: Teach: スリップ/安部/スパイク/発光/王妃/ラケット/昆布/ノンフィクション

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、店の前、雨で、お客さん、スリップせんよう、本気で、対策、せなあかんで、絶対、危ないやんか、本気で。
lines.en: Aoi, listen — the storefront's going to be slick with rain. We've got to do something real about it, or customers are going to slip. It's dangerous, seriously.
lines.style: Urgent, protective energy. Kansai rhythm fast and emphatic. Leans forward with concern, not panic. Voice firm on the safety point—he means it. Shoulders tense slightly on 'dangerous.'

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。バイトの安部さん、本気で、頑張ってくれて、葵で、本当に、頼りに、なる存在です、絶対、本当に、感謝しております。
lines.en: Yes. Abe from the part-time staff—she's been working so hard on it. I really do rely on her. I'm genuinely grateful.
lines.style: Warm and sincere, soft laugh underneath. Direct eye contact. Speaks slowly, like she wants him to know she means each word. A little vulnerable showing gratitude out loud.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: スポーツ応援イベント、葵で、本気で、開催しよか、葵さん、バレーボールのスパイク、上手い選手、呼べたら、ええで、絶対。
lines.en: What if we held a sports event here? We could invite a really good volleyball player—someone with skill. It'd be great for the shop, for real.
lines.style: Bright, energetic forward pitch. Kansai warmth—he's already seeing it happening. Leans in like he's inviting her into the plan. Quick delivery, genuine excitement underneath the sell.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。店内、発光する照明、もう少し、本気で、増やしませんか、葵で、雰囲気、絶対、お洒落に、なりますね、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. You know, we could add a bit more of that warm accent lighting inside—it would make the whole space feel so much more refined, wouldn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, collaborative tone. Speaks gently, like she's offering an idea, not pushing it. Pauses slightly before the question, giving him space to picture it. Warm but not presumptuous.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 特別コースに、王妃のお気に入りだった、本気で、伝統料理、加えよか、葵さん、絶対、お客さん、喜んでくれるで、本気で。
lines.en: And for the special menu—what if we added some of those traditional dishes the queen used to favour? Your customers would be thrilled, I'm sure of it.
lines.style: Warm Kansai conviction. Speaks with ownership of the idea but not arrogance. Slight uptick on 'thrilled'—he can already hear their happiness. Direct and hopeful, not tentative.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。テニス愛好家のお客様、ラケット、本気で、収集されてる方、いらっしゃるんですよ、葵で、本当に、絶対、面白い、お話。
lines.en: Yes. Actually, we have a customer who collects tennis rackets—seriously, they have quite an impressive collection. It's such an interesting story.
lines.style: Delighted recognition. Gentle pride in knowing her regulars this well. Speaks like she's sharing a secret. Slight animation on 'collection,' then softens on 'story'—she wants him to appreciate what makes this person special.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 昆布出汁、本気で、こだわって、葵で、出していきましょう、お客様、本気で、感激してくださるはずやで、絶対、本当に、本気。
lines.en: Let's really commit to the kombu broth—do it right, with real care. The customers will feel the difference. They're going to be genuinely moved by it.
lines.style: Conviction without hardness. Kansai directness on the commitment. Slows down on 'care' and 'moved'—he's talking about something that matters to him. Voice settles with quiet assurance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。店の本棚に、ノンフィクション本、本気で、置きませんか、葵で、お客様、ゆっくり、時間、過ごせる、空間に、なりますね、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. What if we put some good nonfiction on the bookshelf? It would give customers a reason to linger, to really spend time here in a quieter way.
lines.style: Soft, intimate suggestion. Voice warm and close. Speaks like she's imagining the space with him. Slight pause before 'linger'—she's painting a picture. Gentle, unhurried rhythm.
